verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Seated above
Enthroned in the Father's love

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Destined to die
Poured out for all mankind

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
God's only son
Perfect and spotless one

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
He never sinned
But suffered as if he did

verse.name: p1
verse.lines: All authority, every victory is yours (x2)

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Saviour, worthy of honour and glory
Worthy of all our praise
You overcame

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Jesus, awesome in power forever,
Awesome & great is Your name
You overcame

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Power in hand
Speaking the Father's plan

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
You're sending us out
Light in this broken land

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
We will overcome
By the blood of the lamb

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
And the word of our testimony
Everyone overcome
